packMeta.name: PassMaster (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey restaurant front-of-house & kitchen pass: interactive section floor map, reservations book with 1-click table seating, course kitchen pass with red allergy alerts, station prep checklist, brigade roster and nightly shift close. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
